literal_meaning: বগলে চেপে ধরা বা আঁকড়ে ধরা
figurative_meaning_bn: আত্মসাৎ করা; আয়ত্তে আনা; করতলগত করা
figurative_meaning_en: To appropriate; to bring under control; to possess completely
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়িক প্রতিযোগীদের বগলদাবা করতে সে কোনো কৌশল ছাড়েনি।
example_sentences_in_english: He has appropriated the property completely.
He left no strategy unused to bring his business rivals under control.
note: The idiom derives from the physical act of tucking an item securely under the armpit to carry it away, symbolizing firm possession.
